description: "The Cenci" by Alexandre Dumas, Pere is a dramatic historical novel likely written in the early 20th century. The narrative recounts the true story of the Cenci family, particularly focusing on Francesco Cenci's tyrannical and abusive ways towards his wife and children, culminating in a tragic tale of revenge, murder, and the subsequent fate of the Cenci family.
